headline: Paychex Expands WISE to Deliver Workforce Intelligence Across Business Tools
summary: With Microsoft 365 as its first ecosystem, WISE brings insights, guidance, and actions into the tools businesses already use WISE extends Paychex’s workforce intelligence beyond HCM software into collaboration and productivity toolsMicrosoft 365 is the first ecosystem in Paychex’s broader channel expansion strategy, with WISE now available in Microsoft 365 Copilot and TeamsThe platform is designed to help Paychex and its partners expand HCM capabilities across digital workflows ROCHESTER, N.Y.,
